_comment: Week 4 deliverable fixture. expected_filenames is the set of acceptable source filenames -- a question 'hits' if ANY of them appears among the evaluated top-k chunks by filename. Several questions deliberately target the leave-policy-v2023-vs-v2024 near-duplicate collision (same section structure, different entitlement numbers) that MMR is meant to help with.

questions.question: How many casual leave days do employees get?
questions.notes: current entitlement (15 days) -- near-duplicate 2023 chunks (12 days) compete for top-3

questions.question: What is the current sick leave entitlement?
How many days of earned leave carry over to the next year?
What was the casual leave entitlement under the 2023 policy?
questions.notes: explicitly asks for historical data -- the trap in reverse, retrieval should NOT always default to the newest doc
